basic_details.job_title: IWAI Principal Private Secretary Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Inland Waterways Authority of India (IWAI) has notified 1 vacancy for the Principal Private Secretary (PPS) post on a deputation basis, requiring offline applications to be sent by Registered Post or Speed Post only to Assistant Secretary (Admn. & Estt.), Inland Waterways Authority of India, A-13, Sector-1, Noida-201301 (U.P.) within 45 days from date of publication in Employment News. The engagement is initially for a period of 03 years under Employment Notice No. IWAI-17011/4/2026-ADMIN RECTT Dated 23.10.2026. Eligible applicants must be Indian Nationals working in offices of Central/State G

important_dates.last_date_to_apply: 45 days from date of publication of this advertisement in Employment News

age_limit.details: Not exceeding 56 years on the closing date of application.

qualification.details: Officers under Central/State Govts. /Statutory or Autonomous bodies/Public Sector Undertakings fulfilling the following conditions may apply: | Holding analogous posts on regular basis; OR Holding post in the Level 7 or level 8 in the Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC, (Pre-revised PB-2, Rs. 9300-34800+GP Rs. 4600) with 7 years' regular service. | Not exceeding 56 years on the closing date of application.

important_instructions: The Authority is following Central Govt. Rules & Regulations in service matters. Leased accommodation and medical reimbursement are provided as per rules of the Authority. The post has all India transfer liability. Mere possession of essential qualifications will not entitle a candidate to be selected for the post. The decision of the Authority as to the eligibility of a candidate shall be final and no correspondence in this regard will be entertained. Canvassing in any form shall be ground for disqualification. Persons working in Central/State Governments/UTs/PSUs/ Statutory or Autonomous Bodies should submit their application Through Proper Channel. Incomplete application or applications received after the due date or application not received through proper channel are liable to be rejected. The period of deputation shall ordinarily not exceed 3 years.

content_sections.heading: About IWAI Principal Private Secretary
content_sections.text: The Inland Waterways Authority of India functions under the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways, Govt. of India, with its head office located at A-13, Sector -1, Noida – 201301 (U.P.). The Authority follows Central Govt. Rules & Regulations in service matters. Leased accommodation and medical reimbursement are provided as per rules of the Authority.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications in prescribed proforma Through Proper Channel to be addressed to: Assistant Secretary (Admn. & Estt.), IWAI, A-13, Sector-1, Noida-201301 (U.P.) Applications must be sent by Registered Post / Speed Post only , along with self-attested copies of certificates, last 5 year's APAR's, etc. Candidates should send their applications in a closed envelope superscribed “Application for the post of Principal Private Secretary (PPS) on deputation basis, against Employment Notice No. IWAI-17011/4/2026-ADMIN RECTT Dated 23.10.2026” . faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available for the Principal Private Secretary post?
faq.answer: There is one vacant post of Principal Private Secretary (PPS).

faq.question: Q2. What is the pay scale for the Principal Private Secretary post?
faq.answer: The post carries Level 11 in the Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Not exceeding 56 years on the closing date of application.

faq.question: Q4. What are the essential service conditions for eligibility?
faq.answer: Officers under Central/State Govts. /Statutory or Autonomous bodies/Public Sector Undertakings holding analogous posts on regular basis, or holding post in the Level 7 or level 8 in the Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC, (Pre-revised PB-2, Rs. 9300-34800+GP Rs. 4600) with 7 years' regular service.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of application is 45 days from date of publication of this advertisement in Employment News.

faq.question: Q6. How should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications in prescribed proforma Through Proper Channel to be addressed to the Assistant Secretary (Admn. & Estt.), IWAI, A-13, Sector-1, Noida-201301 (U.P.), along with self-attested copies of certificates, last 5 year's APAR's, etc. through Registered Post / Speed Post only.

faq.question: Q7. What documents must be enclosed with the application?
faq.answer: Copies of APAR's, for the past 5 years (from 2021-2022 onwards) along with vigilance clearance, Integrity certificate, self attested testimonials / documents in support of the eligibility criteria as stipulated in the advertisement.
